      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Fridge produces strange noises" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Describe" name="Describe the symptoms" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select" name="Select a local service facility" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Merge" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Appointment" name="Make an appointment" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Arrive" name="Arrive at the customer" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Leave" name="Leave without repairing the fridge" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Repair" name="Repair the fridge" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirm" name="Confirm that the fridge is OK" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Rate" name="Rate the service facility?" default="F_NoRate" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_RateMerge" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End" name="Fridge serviced" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_Describe" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_Describe" targetRef="Task_Send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="Task_Send" targetRef="Task_Select" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="Task_Select" targetRef="Gw_Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="Gw_Merge" targetRef="Task_Appointment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="Task_Appointment" targetRef="Task_Arrive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="Task_Arrive" targetRef="Gw_Parts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Parts" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Parts" targetRef="Task_Leave" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_NoParts" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Parts" targetRef="Task_Repair" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="Task_Leave" targetRef="Gw_Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Task_Confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="Task_Confirm" targetRef="Gw_Rate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Rate" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Rate" targetRef="Task_Rate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_NoRate" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Rate" targetRef="Gw_RateMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="Task_Rate" targetRef="Gw_RateMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="Gw_RateMerge" targetRef="End" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
